name: Remote MCP Server (Authless)
description: A template for deploying an authentication-free remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers. Enables quick deployment of custom tools accessible from MCP clients like Claude Desktop or the Cloudflare AI Playground via SSE endpoints.
